Patch Set 1:

(4 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Looks good - the flag really is dead: nothing has assigned LUSTRE_SET_SYNC_FL since 7b46ff54afb2, and mdt_setattr_unpack() masks client-supplied flags with LUSTRE_FL_USER_MODIFIABLE (0x00040000 is not in it), so neither removed branch was reachable. Only optional comments inline for whenever this is next refreshed - no need to re-spin for them.
